title: Open homepage and reach the first hero phase
description: This test verifies that a visitor can load the homepage, see the interactive hero begin, and observe the first messaging phase as they scroll.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Verify the hero experience is displayed
Scroll down through the hero area
Verify the first hero messaging phase is visible

title: View the interactive hero experience
description: This test verifies that the homepage hero area loads its interactive canvas and phased messaging for a first-time visitor.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Verify the hero canvas animation is displayed
Verify phased hero messaging is visible

title: Use sticky navigation to jump to key sections
description: This test verifies that a visitor can use the sticky header links to move between major sections on the homepage.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Click the navigation link for a major section
Click another navigation link for a different section
Verify the page scrolls to the selected sections
Verify the sticky navigation remains available during browsing

title: Advance through the hero storytelling sequence
description: This test verifies that continued scrolling advances the hero canvas and messaging through the full introductory sequence to the location-focused ending.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Scroll down through the hero area
Continue scrolling through the hero area
Continue scrolling through the hero area
Verify the hero canvas animation advances with scrolling
Verify the final location-focused hero message is visible

title: Use sticky navigation to jump to a key section
description: This test verifies that the sticky header remains usable while scrolling and can move the visitor to a major content section from the navigation links.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Scroll down the page
Open the navigation link for a major section
Verify the header remains available while scrolling
Verify the selected section is displayed

title: Use mobile navigation to jump between sections
description: This test verifies that a small-screen visitor can open the mobile navigation menu, jump to a section, and continue browsing after the menu closes.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Resize the browser to a mobile viewport
Open the mobile navigation menu
Select a section from the mobile navigation menu
Verify the page scrolls to the selected section
Verify the mobile navigation menu closes after selection

title: Open the mobile menu and jump to a section
description: This test verifies that a mobile visitor can open the navigation menu, choose a section, and arrive there successfully.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Resize the browser to a small mobile viewport
Open the mobile navigation menu
Verify the mobile navigation links are displayed
Select a section from the mobile navigation menu
Verify the page scrolls to the selected section

title: View the software training and solutions cards
description: This test verifies that scrolling to the Welcome section reveals both division cards so a visitor can compare the company’s two offerings.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Scroll to the Welcome section
Verify the two division cards are displayed
Verify the section introduces both software training and software solutions

title: View leadership profiles
description: This test verifies that a visitor can scroll to the leadership section and read the leadership cards for the CEO, Director, and Founder.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Scroll to the leadership section
Verify leadership profile cards are displayed
Verify the leadership titles and supporting statements are visible

title: Browse company value propositions
description: This test verifies that a visitor can reach the features section and see the company value proposition cards appear in the grid.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Scroll to the features section
Verify the value proposition cards are displayed
Verify the listed benefits are visible

title: Expand a student support item
description: This test verifies that a visitor can open a Student Success accordion item and read its description.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Scroll to the Student Success section
Expand one accordion item
Verify the selected accordion item is expanded
Verify its description is visible

title: Switch between student support items
description: This test verifies that opening a different Student Success accordion item collapses the first one and shows the newly selected description.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Scroll to the Student Success section
Expand one accordion item
Expand another accordion item
Verify only the newly selected accordion item is expanded
Verify the previous accordion item is collapsed

title: Hover the training institute card to reveal emphasis
description: This test verifies that the software training institute card responds to hover interaction by increasing emphasis and showing its interactive state.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Scroll to the Welcome section
Hover over the training institute card
Verify the training institute card becomes visually emphasized
Verify the training institute card’s interactive action is revealed

title: Hover the software solutions card to reveal emphasis
description: This test verifies that the software solutions card responds to hover interaction by increasing emphasis and showing its interactive state.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Scroll to the Welcome section
Hover over the software solutions card
Verify the software solutions card becomes visually emphasized
Verify the software solutions card’s interactive action is revealed

title: Read all student support principles
description: This test verifies that a visitor can expand each Student Success accordion item one at a time and view all three support descriptions.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Scroll to the Student Success section
Expand the first accordion item
Expand the second accordion item
Expand the third accordion item
Verify each student support principle can be viewed
Verify the accordion keeps only one item expanded at a time

title: Submit a complete contact inquiry
description: This test verifies that a visitor can fill out the contact form with valid details and submit it successfully.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Scroll to the contact form
Fill in the name field with a valid full name
Fill in the phone number field with a valid phone number
Submit the contact form
Verify the form accepts the inquiry
Verify a success confirmation is visible

title: Submit a contact inquiry successfully
description: This test verifies that a visitor can complete the contact form with a name and phone number and see a successful submission state.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Scroll to the contact form
Fill in the name field with Test User
Fill in the phone field with a valid phone number
Submit the contact form
Verify a successful submission confirmation is visible
Verify the form remains usable after submission

title: Complete the contact form after correcting missing input
description: This test verifies that a visitor can fix a missing required field and then successfully submit the contact form.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Scroll to the contact form
Leave the name field empty
Fill in the phone number field with a valid phone number
Submit the contact form
Fill in the name field with a valid full name
Submit the contact form
Verify the form accepts the inquiry
Verify a success confirmation is visible

title: Show validation when the name is missing
description: This test verifies that the contact form blocks submission and indicates missing required information when the name is left empty.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Scroll to the contact form
Leave the name field empty
Fill in the phone number field with a valid phone number
Submit the contact form
Verify a required-field validation error is visible
Verify the form is not accepted

title: Show required-field validation for an incomplete contact inquiry
description: This test verifies that the contact form shows validation feedback when the visitor tries to submit without the required information.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Scroll to the contact form
Submit the contact form without filling required fields
Verify required-field validation is visible
Verify the form is not submitted successfully

title: Show validation when the phone number is missing
description: This test verifies that the contact form blocks submission and indicates missing required information when the phone number is left empty.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Scroll to the contact form
Fill in the name field with a valid full name
Leave the phone number field empty
Submit the contact form
Verify a required-field validation error is visible
Verify the form is not accepted

title: Block submission when both contact fields are empty
description: This test verifies that the contact form requires both fields before allowing submission.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Scroll to the contact form
Leave the name field empty
Leave the phone number field empty
Submit the contact form
Verify a required-field validation error is visible
Verify the form is not accepted

title: Close the mobile menu after selecting a section
description: This test verifies that the mobile navigation menu closes automatically after a section link is selected and does not stay open over the destination content.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Resize the browser to a small mobile viewport
Open the mobile navigation menu
Select a section from the mobile navigation menu
Verify the mobile navigation menu is closed
Verify the selected section is visible
